svg.text: Multi-Omics Knowledge Graph for Marine Microbial Communities
38 strains (Prochlorococcus · Synechococcus · Alteromonas + 4 heterotrophs) · 43 publications · 197 experiments · 283K nodes · 2.7M typed edges

g.text: with full DAG ancestry to root
Every measurement is anchored to a publication, experiment,
and rich metadata (omics type, treatment, organism, time-course).
Genes carry ~28 properties + post-import routing signals;
annotations are graph edges, not flat fields → cleanly composable.
QUERYABLE BY THE LLM AGENT (multiomics-explorer MCP)
40 tools across gene · sequence · expression · ortholog · ontology · cluster · chemistry · metabolomics · enrichment.
Pre-computed indexes & full-text search on the core node types; post-import Cypher derives ranks, percentiles, and routing signals for fast LLM-driven analysis.
Counts measured against the live KG (Schema_info: built 2026-06-03).
